precepts.text: In the kingdom seven women shall take hold of one man, so Christ was not saying there is no marriage in the kingdom, only that there is no more raising up seed for a brother who died.
precepts.point: The Sadducees did not even believe in the resurrection, yet they used scriptures they did not believe to try to confound Christ, the same way Christians and five-percenters take our scriptures they reject and use them to try to confound us.

note.label: Acts 4: The Stone the Builders Rejected

precepts.why:
Christ was not saying there is no marriage in the kingdom: “And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.”

In the kingdom seven women take hold of one man. What Christ answered the Sadducees is that in the resurrection there is no more raising up seed for a brother who died. They erred, not knowing the scriptures nor the power of God.

points: In that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, we will eat our own bread and wear our own apparel, only let us be called by thy name to take away our reproach. There will be no independent women in that day.

points: He that is left in Zion and remaineth in Jerusalem shall be called holy, everyone written among the living, when the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and purged the blood of Jerusalem by the spirit of judgment and the spirit of burning. This is being saved from the destruction.

note.label: Isaiah 4: The Branch of the Lord and the Cleansed Remnant

points: The Lord will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion and upon her assemblies a cloud and smoke by day and the shining of a flaming fire by night, and upon all the glory shall be a defence.
